notes.title: Let’s get this party started! TactiCats is available now!
notes.content:
Hey there! Today is the day, the big party is about to begin! TactiCats is now available on PC and consoles! 😺 

We are extremely happy to announce it with HungryDingo - you can now purchase the game with -15% launch discount and play it with your friends! 🥳

Take part in fast and dynamic competitions, in which you must eliminate your opponents! Knock down your enemies, grow your collection of cute cat-players, use power-ups and complete various tasks & secret challenges in order to win. No holds barred! 🐈‍⬛ 

Time to show everybody who's the fluffiest of them all! 😼

* * *

Take a look at the release trailer ⤵️

[previewyoutube=O7UMEezIdJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: TactiCats is coming to PC, Nintendo Switch & Xbox and has a release date!
notes.content:
Hey there, fans of cats and furr-balls! It's time to sharpen your claws! 🐈 

Together with Hungry Dingo we are pleased to announce that TactiCats is finally coming to launch! Game will be released here on Steam, as well as on Nintendo Switch and Xbox consoles in two weeks, on February 20th, 2025! 

Knock down your enemies, grow your collection of cute cat-players, use power-ups and complete various tasks & secret challenges in order to win! Time to show everyobody, who's the fluffiest of them all! No holds barred! 🐈‍⬛
